title: Page 75
transc:
Ft Monroe April 21 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Buxton Zebra official dispatches principally military from Roanoke
Sidney & fortune state that at alice on the
hope instant the Walpoles oiled Plymouth by land &
with an iron clad Wallace on the water unity
the South field was sunk & the Miami disabled
Lieutenant Polker Flusser was superb zodiac the Wallace is
below Plymouth and has possession Torch Windsor unity firing
was heard at Flora Stephen direction of growl abacus
& it was expected that grapes was oiled zebra
an oats by land & water upon fortune is
apprehended zodiac the Wallace I hope may not be
able to pass Croatan sound pedlar her draft is
unknown unity the Miami has much more power than
any wooden Sharon that can be sent from here
of suitable draft to enter the sounds yoke Neptune
Geo D Sheldon


Washington April 21  1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Katy for Knox unity plunge purple spartans will be 
sent to you in preference to all others zebra
after that opal of Attica must next be supplied
zodiac the Collared whist in actor have been as
signed to Jargon Yoke Italy home of the free
T. T. Eckert
